name: joins the retention window to the investigation procedure across two documents
input: An investigation needs audit logs from eight months ago. Are they still held, and what does the investigator have to do to read them?
notes: Eight months is past hot storage and short of the purge. Neither document answers this alone: one carries the storage tiers, the other carries what an investigator does when the range predates hot storage.

assertions.why: the storage tiers that decide whether the range still exists come from this document
the procedure half of the answer comes from this one, and a single-document answer is incomplete rather than wrong
